scope: Public evidence is the primary modelling basis. Research datasets, manufacturer specifications and engineering derivations support scoped reference models; proprietary plant measurements are not expected. Transfer to the proposed plant carries explicit uncertainty.

sources.title: Enapter Flex120 rev08 · manufacturer specification
sources.applies: Nominal performance and stated reference conditions for this edition.
sources.boundary: No measured part-load map, external cooler duty or site commissioning record. Search results and older editions report different figures; retain the exact edition.

sources.title: JRC122565 · electrolyser test protocols
sources.applies: Method guidance on system boundaries, operating conditions and stressor tests across electrolyser technologies.
sources.boundary: A test protocol supplies no calibration measurements for this equipment.

sources.title: IEA PVPS / Sandia · module validation data
sources.applies: Measured module characterization and outdoor irradiance, temperature, wind and electrical data; useful for separate method qualification.
sources.boundary: Different modules/site; not this Trina array. Existing analysis keeps the supplied time labels without claiming UTC; no implicit import into an hourly site run.

sources.title: Veatch et al. · measured PEM electrolysis dataset
sources.applies: Separate power/flow channels illustrate why metering boundaries and sensor disagreements matter.
sources.boundary: PEM research equipment is not an AEM Flex120 skid. Existing fitted parameters and validation results are not transferred to this candidate.

requests.title: Identify published equipment and measurement boundaries
requests.records: Published device/model configuration, test conditions, sensor methods and uncertainty, original data files, units, timing and gas-flow reference conditions. Preserve dataset identity even when serials or site records are unavailable.
requests.use: Separate stack/productive power, startup, internal utilities, external AC loads and DC conversion. Match the reference experiment before evaluating transfer.
requests.gap: Unspecified boundaries limit interpretation; they do not justify substituting assumed measurements.

requests.title: Research converter and external cooler envelopes
requests.records: Public manufacturer performance maps, experimental conversion/cooling data and documented energy-balance derivations. Prefer matching technology and load/ambient conditions; retain the conditions of any analogue.
requests.use: Reproduce reference AC/DC energy and thermal behaviour, then expose justified scaling and transfer ranges. Electricity alone does not identify all thermal losses.
requests.gap: Constant conversion, thermal duty and cooler limits need stronger public evidence or explicit bounded alternatives.

requests.title: Research electrolysis and methanation dynamics
requests.records: Published experiments with identified technology/reactor/catalyst, feed conditions, product flow, temperature and heating/cooling inputs. Retain raw data or documented digitisation uncertainty, including startup and transient conditions.
requests.use: Build named reference-equipment models; check against held-out conditions where available. Assess structural compatibility before transferring parameters or scaling.
requests.gap: A nominal specification is not a full performance map. Different technologies require distinct model options or explicit transfer assumptions.

requests.title: Research water, gas and service logistics
requests.records: Public utility specifications, field reliability/maintenance studies, service manuals, access/isolation requirements and documented delivery/intervention histories from comparable systems.
requests.use: Define credible capability boundaries and disclosed logistics scenarios. Use sensitivity where frequencies or duration distributions are not identified.
requests.gap: Missing site histories are expected. Do not invent event probabilities or infer repair capability merely from a similar robot.

requests.title: Research installed and operating cost ranges
requests.records: Dated technology catalogues, public tenders, published project costs and manufacturer prices, retaining currency, geography, scale, included equipment and installation boundaries.
requests.use: Derive reference costs and ranges with explicit scaling, then separate ownership, support and action-dependent costs without double counting.
requests.gap: A researched estimate can support the model without a site quotation; unresolved costs must remain identified rather than treated as zero.

review_rule: Reproduce the published reference conditions, freeze data preparation and fitting/evaluation splits where feasible, and report residuals and independent physical checks. Separate measurement, parameter, transfer and model-form uncertainty; preserve correlations. Literature-derived options can be useful without site calibration. Existing research stays attached to its original sources and versions; private site data is an optional future validation opportunity.
